objective:
Course Description

The invention of the laser stands among the most significant technological breakthroughs of the twentieth century, transforming numerous scientific, industrial, and medical disciplines. Today, laser technology plays an increasingly important role in modern healthcare, offering minimally invasive, precise, and efficient treatment options across a wide range of medical and dental specialties.

This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the fundamental principles, safety considerations, and clinical applications of laser technology in medicine and dentistry. Students will gain an understanding of laser physics, laser-tissue interactions, and evidence-based treatment protocols, while exploring the latest advancements in laser-assisted procedures.

Key Topics Include:

Fundamentals of Laser Physics
Laser Safety Standards and Regulations
Laser-Tissue Interaction Mechanisms
Medical and Dental Laser Applications
Laser Use in Periodontology
Surgical Applications in Oral and Maxillofacial Procedures
Laser-Assisted Teeth Whitening (Bleaching)
Low-Level Laser Therapy (LLLT) and Photobiomodulation
Practical Hands-on Sessions and Participation in the Dental Laser Association
